title: ATS Handling Audit
requirements: Audit NSAppTransportSecurity in Info.plist: confirm the exception for api.openai.com is present and scoped (NSAllowsArbitraryLoads=false); verify no broader exceptions
Extend WhisperClientError with a networkUnavailable case mapping TLS-rejected / network-unavailable responses; errorDescription reads "Network unavailable: transcription failed"
Surface TLS / network failures to the user via the error-banner pathway defined in finish-recording-error-feedback (not a silent hang or restated empty error)
Document the api.openai.com ATS exception as a known risk in specs/decisions.md: OpenAI may rotate endpoints without notice; if they do, this exception must be updated
acceptance_criteria: Disconnecting the network and running transcription yields a clear 'network unavailable' toast/banner, not a silent hang
A TLS-rejected connection reports whisperError(0) (or networkUnavailable) with an errorDescription
ATS exceptions in Info.plist are scoped to api.openai.com only; NSAllowsArbitraryLoads is false
